title: Townsend Brown's electrogravitics experiments in the late 1920s

tellings.quote: Okay. So late 1920s they were using very high voltage material uh resonant frequencies certain frequencies at very high voltage but low power.

plain: In the late 1920s the physicist Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have experimented with electrogravitics, the idea that very high voltage could produce a push like a force against gravity, using "very high voltage but low power" at certain resonant frequencies, with work also linked to Germany. Steven Greer, who runs a group collecting testimony about secret UFO technology, tells it as a researcher's summary, crediting his own collection, the Disclosure Project Intelligence Archive, and offers it as an early root of hidden propulsion science.
